goal: Stop identical relayed address announcements from artificially inflating address presence in the new table
agreement: Unaddressed objection: genuinely newer announcements are blocked when the refresh fires (taki-abedesselam)
Verified by testing that duplicate announcements no longer inflate multiplicity (frankomosh)
Support because it reduces inflated address counts on onion and i2p nodes (stratospher)
Requests better documentation of timestamp update rules (danielabrozzoni)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes a minor logic bug in address management freshness checks
Limited adversarial benefit because attackers can easily bypass it by varying announcement timestamps
